title: Ihanga Ryateye akagere Urutonde rw'Ivyaduka
intro: Mu karere inkuru yaco isubiramwo mu bihe vyose, hari umuryango wabayeho mu kugarariza ku mugaragaro amategeko y’ubugororotsi. Ivyo bakoze vyari biteye ubwoba cane ku buryo vyibukwa nk’imburi ku bantu bose. None abo bantu bari bande, kandi ni igiki cabashikiye?
clues: Twaba mu gihugu kiri iruhande y’inzira abagenzi bakunda gucamwo, mugabo twatuma urugendo rwabo rugira akaga.
Twarakoze ibikorwa nk’ivyo vy’ubusambanyi ata n’umwe mu masi yari bwigere abikora.
Intumwa ivuye muri twebwe yaduhamagariye guheba inzira zacu, ariko turayihakana, dusaba igihano nimba ari umunyakuri.
Iyo abashitsi beza cane baje mu gisagara cacu, twararondera kubatera, tutazi ko ari intumwa z’ugutikiza.
Twaragabishijwe igihano giteye ubwoba iyo tutavyihojeje, ariko twatwenga iyo ngabisho maze tuguma mu caha cacu.
Imvura y’amabuye ivuye mw’ijuru iradugwako, amazu yacu aratembagazwa, nta n’akarongo kasigaye kiretse ikimenyetso ku bazirikana.

trial.answer: Yakoze ubusambanyi butagira uko bungana yongera arazibira amabarabara .

arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient." (29:34)
